description: This file provides compatibility wrappers around the OpenWrt 'uci' configuration management utility. It defines functions for loading, setting, resetting, toggling, adding, removing, renaming, and committing configuration entries, as well as retrieving configuration data. The script manages environment variables and interacts with external 'uci' commands to facilitate configuration management within the OpenWrt system.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads configuration data for a specified package using the 'uci' command and evaluates the resulting data.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default configuration for a package if it is not already set by importing and committing the package.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts a configuration to a previous state based on stored state data.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific configuration option in the stored state.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a configuration option in the stored state, effectively toggling it.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds a value to a list-type configuration option.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value from the stored state.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value, with a default fallback if not present.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new configuration section or sets its type.

methods.name: uci_remove
methods.description: Removes a configuration section or option.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes a specific value from a list-type configuration option.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts changes to a configuration section or option.

methods.name: uci_commit
methods.description: Commits configuration changes for a package.
